name: The Inn
source: The Inn tells the story of down on his luck kind of guy. He's been living by himself in the big city ever since his father kicked him out of his house at the age of 18. He really lives a miserable life... But it's all about to take a 180º turn when he meets a certain person one night.
translation: 《旅馆》讲述了一个运气不佳的人的故事。自从18岁被父亲赶出家门后，他就一直一个人生活在大城市。他的日子过得实在是悲惨……但有一天晚上，他遇到了一个人，一切都发生了180度的大转变。
